reading.title: The Impact of Social Media on Mental Health
reading.passage: Recent studies indicate that excessive social media usage significantly affects adolescent mental health. Platforms like Instagram and TikTok create unrealistic standards through curated content, leading to increased anxiety and depression. However, social media also provides communities for isolated individuals. Researchers suggest that moderation and digital literacy education are essential. The key lies not in eliminating social media entirely, but in developing healthy consumption habits and critical thinking skills to navigate the digital landscape responsibly.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one negative effect of social media on adolescents?
options: It creates unrealistic standards through curated content
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'Platforms like Instagram and TikTok create unrealistic standards through curated content, leading to increased anxiety and depression'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What solution does the passage suggest for healthy social media use?
questions.explanation: 'Researchers suggest that moderation and digital literacy education are essential'라는 문장에서 해결책을 제시하고 있습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is mentioned as a positive aspect of social media?
options: It provides communities for isolated individuals
It removes the need for face-to-face interaction
questions.explanation: 본문의 'However, social media also provides communities for isolated individuals'에서 긍정적인 측면을 언급하고 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made our lives better than they were 100 years ago'? Use specific examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 명확한 주장 제시: 동의하는지 불동의하는지 직접 표현. 예: 'I strongly agree that technology has significantly improved our quality of life'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유와 구체적 사례 제시. 의료, 통신, 교육 등의 분야에서 기술의 혁신성 설명
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유와 구체적 사례 제시. 환경 문제나 사회적 영향 등 다각적 관점 포함 가능
structure.conclusion: 주장을 재강조하되 새로운 내용 추가 없이 요약. 미래에 대한 간단한 언급으로 마무리

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to study in a quiet library environment. Others prefer to study in a bustling café with background noise. Which environment do you prefer for studying, and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer studying in a library because
One reason is that a quiet environment helps me concentrate better
Another important point is that I can avoid distractions when studying alone
I believe this is better because
sample_points: 조용한 도서관 환경에서는 집중력이 향상되어 학습 효율이 높아진다는 점
카페 환경의 배경 소음은 때로 주의 산만을 유발하지만, 적절한 음악은 창의성을 높일 수 있다는 상충된 관점

listening.title: Professor's Lecture on Climate Change Solutions
listening.script: Good morning everyone. Today we'll discuss renewable energy as a solution to climate change. Traditional fossil fuels have dominated our energy systems for centuries, but they're major contributors to greenhouse gas emissions. Renewable sources like solar, wind, and hydroelectric power offer sustainable alternatives. Solar panels convert sunlight directly into electricity, while wind turbines harness kinetic energy. Hydroelectric plants use flowing water to generate power. These technologies have become increasingly cost-effective. Germany, for example, now generates over 50 percent of its electricity from renewables. However, challenges remain. Intermittency is a major issue—the sun doesn't always shine, and wind doesn't always blow. Battery storage technology is advancing rapidly to address this. Additionally, transitioning existing infrastructure requires significant investment and political will. Despite these obstacles, renewable energy represents our most viable path toward reducing carbon emissions and combating climate change effectively.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the lecture?
options: Renewable energy as a solution to climate change
questions.explanation: 교수가 'Today we'll discuss renewable energy as a solution to climate change'라고 명시적으로 주제를 제시했습니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, what is one major challenge with renewable energy?
options: Intermittency—solar and wind power are not always available
It produces more emissions than fossil fuels
questions.explanation: 강의에서 'Intermittency is a major issue—the sun doesn't always shine, and wind doesn't always blow'라고 명확히 설명했습니다.

questions.q: Which country is mentioned as an example of successful renewable energy adoption?
questions.explanation: 'Germany, for example, now generates over 50 percent of its electricity from renewables'라는 구절에서 독일이 사례로 제시되었습니다.
